usageNotes: Use this to read live Ceph configuration values from a specific node's ceph.conf or the Ceph monitor config DB without shelling into the node. Requires `Sys.Audit` on `/`, and the target node must be online and have Ceph configured. Note that the response normalizes underscores to hyphens in both section and key names, so `osd_pool_default_size` will appear as `osd-pool-default-size` in the returned map.

examples.summary: Read the default pool size and OSD journal size from the global section

tips: Multiple keys can be separated by semicolons, commas, or spaces — all three delimiters are equivalent.
Section names are case-insensitive and lowercased; key names are case-sensitive in the pattern but normalized with hyphens in the response.
Values sourced from the mon config DB take precedence over ceph.conf entries when both exist.
If a requested key is not set, it will be absent from the returned object rather than present with a null value.
